title: FLA writer: emit Contents CMediaSound/CMediaBits media-catalog records
description: Split off from 1205. saveRealFla() now writes the §11 frame sound sub-block (soundId etc.) byte-correctly, verified via parseFla8Timeline round-trip. BUT the writer does not emit the Contents media catalog: writeContents() accepts a 'media' field (ContentsMediaEntry[]) but never serializes it. The importer resolves a frame's soundId -> library item via a 'Media N' / CMediaSound catalog scan (flash8-binary.ts registerCMediaSoundObject + the CMediaSound/CMediaBits FFFF-class discovery flow), so a saved frame sound's library LINK is not rebuilt on a full tryLoadRealFla re-import (warns 'frame sound id N not found in library'). Implement real CMediaSound (schema 6) and CMediaBits NEWCLASS objects in contents-write.ts referencing 'Media N' stream names, advancing the §5.2 combined-table index (two slots/class). RISK: byte-unverified vs a real Flash 8 oracle; the CONTENTS_POST_STAGE template self-declares CColorDef/CQTAudioSettings and must stay valid; carchive-validate stops at the CDocumentPage chain so structural validation is partial. Validate against fixtures/evaporatingdrip.fla (has Media 4 = a sound) and the strict validator. Acceptance: a saved doc with a sound library item + frame sound round-trips through tryLoadRealFla with frame.sound.libraryItemId resolved.
